// ===== src/app/(main)/my-workspace/page.tsx =====
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/auth-context';
import { OnboardingGuide as OnboardingGuideCard } from '@/components/onboarding-guide';
import { PageHint } from '@/components/page-hint';
import {
  LayoutList, Bot, MessageSquare, ClipboardList,
  GraduationCap, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertCircle,
  ChevronRight, Sparkles, ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';

interface WorkOrder {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  customer_name: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function MyWorkspacePage() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [orderTab, setOrderTab] = useState<'pending' | 'processing' | 'done'>('pending');
  const [trainingPct, setTrainingPct] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Fetch my work orders
    const fetchOrders = async () => {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
        const res = await fetch('/api/work-orders', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          // Staff only sees their own orders
          setOrders(Array.isArray(data) ? data.slice(0, 20) : []);
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    };

    // Calculate training progress from localStorage
    const calcTraining = () => {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(`learning-path-progress_${profile?.id || ''}`);
        if (!raw) {
          // fallback to legacy key
          const legacyRaw = localStorage.getItem('learning-path-progress');
          if (legacyRaw) {
            const progress = JSON.parse(legacyRaw);
            const total = 15;
            const done = Object.values(progress).filter(Boolean).length;
            setTrainingPct(Math.round((done / total) * 100));
          }
        } else {
          const progress = JSON.parse(raw);
          const total = 15; // 3 stages × 5 modules
          const done = Object.values(progress).filter(Boolean).length;
          setTrainingPct(Math.round((done / total) * 100));
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    };

    fetchOrders();
    calcTraining();
  }, []);

  const filteredOrders = orders.filter(o => {
    if (orderTab === 'pending') return o.status === 'pending' || o.status === '待处理';
    if (orderTab === 'processing') return o.status === 'processing' || o.status === '处理中';
    return o.status === 'done' || o.status === 'completed' || o.status === '已完成';
  });

  const pendingCount = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'pending' || o.status === '待处理').length;
  const processingCount = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'processing' || o.status === '处理中').length;
  const doneCount = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'done' || o.status === 'completed' || o.status === '已完成').length;

  const displayName = profile?.displayName || '客服';

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto animate-fade-in-up">
      {/* Welcome */}
      <div className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-sky-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
            <LayoutList className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">我的工作台</h1>
        </div>
        <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm ml-[52px]">{displayName}，今天也要加油！</p>
      </div>

      <PageHint text="你的工作中心——待办、话术、培训、工单，该干的都在这。" />

      {/* 7天快速上手指南 */}
      <div className="mt-4">
        <OnboardingGuideCard
          guideKey="my-workspace"
          steps={[
            { title: '查看今日待办', description: '待处理的工单和任务都在这里' },
            { title: '学习话术练兵', description: '掌握标准话术，提升服务效率' },
            { title: '使用AI助手', description: '遇到问题随时问AI，快速找到答案' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 欢迎引导 - 工单为空且培训未开始时显示 */}
      {orders.length === 0 && trainingPct === 0 && (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="text-2xl">👋</span>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-sky-800">欢迎！建议先从AI助手或培训学院开始</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-sky-600 mt-0.5">先学会用工具，再实战处理问题</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Link href="/ai-assistant?prompt=帮我处理一个售后问题" className="text-xs bg-[#0F2B46] text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-[#1a3a5c] transition-colors">试试AI助手</Link>
            <Link href="/training" className="text-xs bg-white text-sky-700 border border-sky-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-sky-50 transition-colors">开始培训</Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Quick Entry Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-6">
        {/* AI Assistant */}
        <Link href="/ai-assistant?prompt=帮我处理一个售后问题" className="group block">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-sky-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-blue-50 p-5 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-sky-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                <Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <span className="font-semibold text-sky-900">AI急救站</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400 ml-auto group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-sky-700">遇到不会处理的问题，问AI，3秒给答案</p>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* Practice */}
        <Link href="/practice" className="group block">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-purple-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-fuchsia-50 p-5 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-purple-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <span className="font-semibold text-purple-900">话术练兵</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400 ml-auto group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-purple-700">AI生成+模拟对练，越练越会说话</p>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* Training */}
        <Link href="/training" className="group block">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 to-teal-50 p-5 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-emerald-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-900">培训中心</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 ml-auto group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">SOP流程+操作规范，按步骤学</p>
          </div>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Two Column Layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mt-6">
        {/* My Work Orders */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ClipboardList className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-lg">我的工单</h2>
              <span className="text-xs bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{orders.length}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4">
            {/* Status Tabs */}
            <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg p-1">
              {([
                { key: 'pending' as const, label: '待处理', count: pendingCount },
                { key: 'processing' as const, label: '处理中', count: processingCount },
                { key: 'done' as const, label: '已完成', count: doneCount },
              ]).map(tab => (
                <button
                  key={tab.key}
                  onClick={() => setOrderTab(tab.key)}
                  className={`flex-1 text-xs font-medium py-1.5 px-2 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                    orderTab === tab.key ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-blue-700' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {tab.label} ({tab.count})
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Order List */}
            {filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-8">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-2" />
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
                  {orderTab === 'done' ? '暂无已完成的工单' : orderTab === 'processing' ? '暂无处理中的工单' : '暂无待处理工单 📋'}
                </p>
                {orderTab === 'pending' && orders.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">所有工单处理完毕，干得漂亮！</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredOrders.slice(0, 5).map(order => (
                  <div key={order.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg">
                    <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                      order.priority === 'high' || order.priority === '紧急' ? 'bg-red-500' :
                      order.priority === 'medium' || order.priority === '一般' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-slate-400'
                    }`} />
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{order.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{order.customer_name}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                      order.status === 'pending' || order.status === '待处理' ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600' :
                      order.status === 'processing' || order.status === '处理中' ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600' :
                      'bg-green-50 text-green-600'
                    }`}>
                      {order.status === 'pending' ? '待处理' : order.status === 'processing' ? '处理中' : '已完成'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            <Link href="/work-orders" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-3 text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium">
              查看全部工单 <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Training Progress */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-lg">培训进度</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-5">
            {/* Progress Ring */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-6 mb-6">
              <div className="relative w-24 h-24">
                <svg className="w-24 h-24 -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 96 96">
                  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" strokeWidth="8" />
                  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth="8"
                    strokeDasharray={`${(trainingPct / 100) * 251.3} 251.3`}
                    strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{trainingPct}%</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-1">学习路径完成度</p>
                <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {trainingPct === 0 ? '📚 暂未开始' : trainingPct < 50 ? '继续加油' : trainingPct < 100 ? '进展不错' : '已全部完成！'}
                </p>
                {trainingPct === 0 ? (
                  <Link href="/training" className="text-xs text-sky-600 hover:text-sky-700 mt-1 inline-block">点击培训学院开始学习 →</Link>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">3个阶段 · 15个模块</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Training Links */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Link href="/learning-path" className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-100 transition-colors">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700">继续学习路径</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 ml-auto" />
              </Link>
              <Link href="/training" className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors">
                <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-blue-700">SOP操作流程</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 ml-auto" />
              </Link>
              <Link href="/knowledge-qa" className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-purple-50 rounded-lg hover:bg-purple-100 transition-colors">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-purple-700">知识问答</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400 ml-auto" />
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Today's Todo */}
      <div className="mt-6 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-lg">今日待办</h2>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {pendingCount > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-amber-50 rounded-lg">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                <span className="text-sm">有 <strong className="text-amber-700">{pendingCount}</strong> 个工单待处理</span>
                <Link href="/work-orders" className="ml-auto text-xs text-amber-600 hover:underline">去处理</Link>
              </div>
            )}
            {trainingPct < 100 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                <span className="text-sm">学习路径还有 <strong className="text-emerald-700">{100 - trainingPct}%</strong> 未完成</span>
                <Link href="/learning-path" className="ml-auto text-xs text-emerald-600 hover:underline">继续学习</Link>
              </div>
            )}
            {pendingCount === 0 && trainingPct >= 100 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                <span className="text-sm text-green-700">今天的事情都做完了，试试AI急救站提升自己？</span>
                <Link href="/ai-assistant" className="ml-auto text-xs text-green-600 hover:underline">去试试</Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ========== 内容区域通用样式组件 ========== */
function ContentSection({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="py-4">
      <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 text-base">{title}</h4>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ========== 长文本智能换行渲染 ========== */
function renderDetailText(text: string, className: string = 'text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed') {
  // 按"→"拆分
  const arrowParts = text.split('→');
  if (arrowParts.length <= 1) {
    // 没有→，检查是否含序号 1. 2. 等
    const numberedMatch = text.match(/(\d+\.\s)/g);
    if (numberedMatch && numberedMatch.length > 1) {
      // 按序号拆分：先找到第一个序号前的文本，然后逐段拆分
      const parts = text.split(/(?=\d+\.\s)/).filter(Boolean);
      return (
        <div className={className}>
          {parts.map((part, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
              {part.trim().match(/^\d+\./) && <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-sky-700">{part.trim().match(/^(\d+\.)/)?.[1]}</span>}
              <span>{part.trim().replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
    }
    return <p className={className}>{text}</p>;
  }

  // 有→，逐段展示
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {arrowParts.map((part, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
          {i > 0 && <span className="shrink-0 text-sky-500 font-bold">→</span>}
          <span>{part.trim()}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ========== SOP内容渲染组件 ========== */
function SOPContentRenderer({ desc }: { desc: string }) {
  const [copiedIdx, setCopiedIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, idx: number) => {
    // 提取话术文本（去掉引号和⚠️标注）
    const cleanText = text.replace(/^[「""""]|[」""""]$/g, '').trim();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanText).then(() => {
      setCopiedIdx(idx);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedIdx(null), 1500);
    }).catch(() => {});
  };

  // 解析三段式内容
  const principleMatch = desc.match(/【处理原则】([\s\S]*?)(?=【分步操作】|$)/);
  const stepsMatch = desc.match(/【分步操作】([\s\S]*?)(?=【结果判定】|$)/);
  const resultMatch = desc.match(/【结果判定】([\s\S]*?)$/);

  const principle = principleMatch?.[1]?.trim() || '';
  const stepsBlock = stepsMatch?.[1]?.trim() || '';
  const resultBlock = resultMatch?.[1]?.trim() || '';

  // 解析分步操作：格式为 序号|操作动作|话术
  const stepLines = stepsBlock.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim() && /^\d+\|/.test(l.trim()));
  const steps = stepLines.map(line => {
    const parts = line.trim().split('|');
    return {
      step: parts[0]?.trim() || '',
      action: parts[1]?.trim() || '',
      script: parts.slice(2).join('|').trim() || '', // 话术可能包含|
    };
  });

  // 解析结果判定：✅ 和 ❌ 分开
  const resultLines = resultBlock.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
  const passResults = resultLines.filter(l => l.trim().startsWith('✅'));
  const failResults = resultLines.filter(l => l.trim().startsWith('❌'));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* 处理原则 */}
      {principle && (
        <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-start gap-2">
          <span className="shrink-0 text-base">💡</span>
          <span className="text-sm text-blue-800 leading-relaxed">{principle}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 分步操作表格 */}
      {steps.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-gray-700 w-[140px] border-b border-gray-200">操作步骤</th>
                <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-gray-700 border-b border-gray-200">可复制话术</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {steps.map((s, i) => {
                // 提取⚠️注意事项
                const warnMatch = s.script.match(/⚠️(.+)$/);
                const mainScript = s.script.replace(/⚠️.+$/, '').trim();
                const warning = warnMatch?.[1]?.trim() || '';
                return (
                  <tr key={i} className={i < steps.length - 1 ? 'border-b border-gray-100' : ''}>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 align-top">
                      <div className="font-medium text-gray-800"><span className="text-sky-700 mr-1">{s.step}.</span>{s.action}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 align-top">
                      <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-start gap-2">
                        <span className="text-gray-700 leading-relaxed flex-1 whitespace-pre-line">{mainScript}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(s.script, i)}
                          className="shrink-0 p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors rounded"
                          title="复制话术"
                        >
                          {copiedIdx === i ? <Check size={13} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={13} />}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      {warning && (
                        <span className="inline-block mt-1 text-[11px] bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium">⚠️ {warning}</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 结果判定 */}
      {(passResults.length > 0 || failResults.length > 0) && (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {passResults.map((r, i) => {
            // 解析 ✅解决 → 话术："..." → 动作：...
            const content = r.replace(/^✅\s*/, '').trim();
            return (
              <div key={`pass-${i}`} className="bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 flex items-start gap-2">
                <span className="shrink-0 text-green-600 font-bold text-sm">✅</span>
                <span className="text-sm text-green-800 leading-relaxed">{content}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {failResults.map((r, i) => {
            const content = r.replace(/^❌\s*/, '').trim();
            return (
              <div key={`fail-${i}`} className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 flex items-start gap-2">
                <span className="shrink-0 text-red-500 font-bold text-sm">❌</span>
                <span className="text-sm text-red-800 leading-relaxed">{content}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function isSOPContent(desc: string): boolean {
  return desc.includes('【处理原则】') || desc.includes('【分步操作】');
}

function renderSOPContent(desc: string) {
  return <SOPContentRenderer desc={desc} />;
}

/* ========== Portal组件（解决transform影响fixed定位） ========== */
function ModalPortal({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { setMounted(true); }, []);
  if (!mounted) return null;
  return createPortal(children, document.body);
}

/* ========== 👍👎 反馈按钮组件 ========== */
const FeedbackButtons = memo(function FeedbackButtons({
  helpful, unhelpful, myType, onFeedback, disabled,
}: {
  helpful: number;
  unhelpful: number;
  myType: string | undefined;
  onFeedback: (type: 'helpful' | 'unhelpful') => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs select-none">
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onFeedback('helpful')}
        className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded transition-colors ${
          myType === 'helpful'
            ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-600'
            : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-50'
        } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}
        title="有用"
      >
        <ThumbsUp size={12} />
        {helpful > 0 && <span>{helpful}</span>}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => onFeedback('unhelpful')}
        className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded transition-colors ${
          myType === 'unhelpful'
            ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-600'
            : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-50'
        } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}
        title="待改进"
      >
        <ThumbsDown size={12} />
        {unhelpful > 0 && <span>{unhelpful}</span>}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 弹窗容器（独立memo，避免主组件state变化时重渲染） ========== */
const ModalContainer = memo(function ModalContainer({
  editModal, newModal, importModal, deleteConfirm, confirmDialog,
  quickPhraseModal, imageUploadModal, customMeaningModal, imagePreview,
  saving, uploading,
  onSaveEdit, onSaveNew, onImport, onDeleteConfirm, onConfirmDialog,
  onSaveQuickPhrase, onUploadImage, onSaveCustomMeaning,
  onCloseEdit, onCloseNew, onCloseImport, onCloseDelete, onCloseQuickPhrase, onCloseImageUpload, onCloseCustomMeaning,
  onCloseImagePreview, onRetry,
}: {
  editModal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string; itemId?: string } | null;
  newModal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string } | null;
  importModal: boolean;
  deleteConfirm: { itemId: string } | null;
  confirmDialog: { open: boolean; title: string; message: string; confirmLabel: string; onConfirm: () => void } | null;
  quickPhraseModal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string } | null;
  imageUploadModal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number } | null;
  customMeaningModal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string; title?: string; isNewItem?: boolean } | null;
  imagePreview: string | null;
  saving: boolean;
  uploading: boolean;
  onSaveEdit: (title: string, content: string) => void;
  onSaveNew: (title: string, content: string) => void;
  onImport: (json: string) => void;
  onDeleteConfirm: () => void;
  onConfirmDialog: () => void;
  onSaveQuickPhrase: (text: string) => void;
  onUploadImage: (file: File) => void;
  onSaveCustomMeaning: (text: string, title?: string) => void;
  onCloseEdit: () => void;
  onCloseNew: () => void;
  onCloseImport: () => void;
  onCloseDelete: () => void;
  onCloseQuickPhrase: () => void;
  onCloseImageUpload: () => void;
  onCloseCustomMeaning: () => void;
  onCloseImagePreview: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {/* ===== 删除确认弹窗 ===== */}
      {deleteConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={onCloseDelete}>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-sm p-6" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">确认删除</h3>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-5">删除后可恢复，确定要删除吗？</p>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={onCloseDelete} className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 font-medium hover:bg-gray-50">取消</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={onDeleteConfirm} className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 text-white font-medium hover:bg-red-700">删除</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ===== 通用确认弹窗 ===== */}
      {confirmDialog?.open && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={onConfirmDialog}>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-sm p-6" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{confirmDialog.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-5">{confirmDialog.message}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={onConfirmDialog} className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 font-medium hover:bg-gray-50">取消</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={confirmDialog.onConfirm} className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0F2B46] text-white font-medium hover:bg-[#1a3a5c]">{confirmDialog.confirmLabel}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ===== 编辑弹窗 ===== */}
      {editModal && (
        <EditModal
          initialTitle={editModal.title}
          initialContent={editModal.content}
          onSave={onSaveEdit}
          onClose={onCloseEdit}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 新增弹窗 ===== */}
      {newModal && (
        <NewModal
          onSave={onSaveNew}
          onClose={onCloseNew}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 导入弹窗 ===== */}
      {importModal && (
        <ImportModal
          onImport={onImport}
          onClose={onCloseImport}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 快捷语编辑弹窗 ===== */}
      {quickPhraseModal && (
        <QuickPhraseModal
          initialText={quickPhraseModal.text}
          onSave={onSaveQuickPhrase}
          onClose={onCloseQuickPhrase}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 示例图上传弹窗 ===== */}
      {imageUploadModal && (
        <ImageUploadModal
          onUpload={onUploadImage}
          onClose={onCloseImageUpload}
          uploading={uploading}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 自定义含义编辑弹窗 ===== */}
      {customMeaningModal && (
        <CustomMeaningModal
          initialText={customMeaningModal.text}
          initialTitle={customMeaningModal.title}
          isNewItem={customMeaningModal.isNewItem}
          moduleKey={customMeaningModal.moduleKey}
          onSave={onSaveCustomMeaning}
          onClose={onCloseCustomMeaning}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 图片大图预览 ===== */}
      {imagePreview && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={onCloseImagePreview}>
          <div className="relative max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh]" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img src={imagePreview} alt="预览" className="max-w-full max-h-[85vh] object-contain rounded-lg" />
            <button type="button" onClick={onCloseImagePreview} className="absolute -top-3 -right-3 w-8 h-8 bg-white rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900">
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
});

/* ========== 配件图鉴组件 ========== */
const AccessoryGallerySection = memo(function AccessoryGallerySection({ accessories, onUpload, onDelete, onRename, onAdd, isAdmin }: {
  accessories: { id: string; name: string; image_url: string | null; is_default: boolean; company_id: string }[];
  onUpload: (id: string, file: File) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
  onRename: (id: string, newName: string) => void;
  onAdd: (name: string, file: File | null) => void;
  isAdmin: boolean;
}) {
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newImageFile, setNewImageFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [newImagePreview, setNewImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState('');
  const [showAdd, setShowAdd] = useState(false);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLInputElement | null>>({});
  const addFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="mt-4">
      <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-lg">📸</span> 配件图鉴
      </h4>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {accessories.map((acc) => (
          <div key={acc.id} className="relative group rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden">
            {/* 图片区域 */}
            <div className="aspect-square bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center relative">
              {acc.image_url ? (
                <img
                  src={acc.image_url}
                  alt={acc.name}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                  onClick={() => setPreviewUrl(acc.image_url)}
                />
              ) : (
                <label className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors w-full h-full justify-center">
                  <Camera size={28} />
                  <span className="text-xs">上传图片</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    className="hidden"
                    ref={el => { fileInputRefs.current[acc.id] = el; }}
                    onChange={e => {
                      const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                      if (f) onUpload(acc.id, f);
                    }}
                  />
                </label>
              )}
              {/* 已有图片时显示替换按钮 */}
              {acc.image_url && isAdmin && (
                <label className="absolute bottom-1 right-1 bg-white/80 rounded-full p-1 cursor-pointer opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <Camera size={14} className="text-gray-500" />
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={e => {
                      const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                      if (f) onUpload(acc.id, f);
                    }}
                  />
                </label>
              )}
            </div>
            {/* 名称区域 */}
            <div className="px-2 py-2 text-center">
              {editingId === acc.id ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editName}
                    onChange={e => setEditName(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={e => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter' && editName.trim()) {
                        onRename(acc.id, editName.trim());
                        setEditingId(null);
                      }
                      if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditingId(null);
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 px-2 py-1 border border-blue-400 rounded text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-400"
                    autoFocus
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (editName.trim()) {
                        onRename(acc.id, editName.trim());
                        setEditingId(null);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="p-1 text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50 rounded"
                    title="保存"
                  >
                    <Check size={14} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setEditingId(null)}
                    className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded"
                    title="取消"
                  >
                    <X size={14} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800">{acc.name}</span>
              )}
            </div>
            {/* 编辑按钮 */}
            {isAdmin && editingId !== acc.id && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setEditingId(acc.id); setEditName(acc.name); }}
                className="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-white/80 rounded-full p-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity hover:bg-blue-50"
                title="修改名称"
              >
                <Pencil size={14} className="text-blue-500" />
              </button>
            )}
            {/* 删除按钮 */}
            {isAdmin && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onDelete(acc.id)}
                className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-white/80 rounded-full p-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity hover:bg-red-100"
                title="删除配件"
              >
                <X size={14} className="text-red-500" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {/* 添加新配件 */}
      {isAdmin && (
        <div className="mt-3">
          {showAdd ? (
            <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 bg-gray-50 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 w-16 shrink-0">名称</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={e => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="输入配件名称"
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 w-16 shrink-0">图片</label>
                <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                  {newImagePreview ? (
                    <div className="relative w-14 h-14 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-200">
                      <img src={newImagePreview} alt="预览" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => { setNewImageFile(null); setNewImagePreview(null); }}
                        className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-white rounded-full p-0.5 shadow hover:bg-red-50"
                      >
                        <X size={12} className="text-red-500" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 border border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-500 hover:border-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors">
                    <Camera size={16} />
                    <span>{newImagePreview ? '更换图片' : '选择图片'}</span>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      className="hidden"
                      ref={addFileInputRef}
                      onChange={e => {
                        const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                        if (f) {
                          setNewImageFile(f);
                          setNewImagePreview(URL.createObjectURL(f));
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-end pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (newName.trim()) {
                      onAdd(newName.trim(), newImageFile);
                      setNewName('');
                      setNewImageFile(null);
                      setNewImagePreview(null);
                      setShowAdd(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={!newName.trim()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  添加
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setShowAdd(false); setNewName(''); setNewImageFile(null); setNewImagePreview(null); }}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-200 text-gray-600 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-gray-300"
                >
                  取消
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAdd(true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium"
            >
              <Plus size={16} /> 添加配件
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* 图片大图预览 */}
      {previewUrl && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={() => setPreviewUrl(null)}>
          <div className="relative max-w-lg w-full" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <img src={previewUrl} alt="配件大图" className="w-full rounded-xl" />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPreviewUrl(null)}
              className="absolute -top-3 -right-3 bg-white rounded-full p-1.5 shadow-lg hover:bg-gray-100"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 独立弹窗组件（memo包裹，避免主页面state变化导致重渲染） ========== */

/* 快捷语编辑弹窗 */
const QuickPhraseModal = memo(function QuickPhraseModal({
  initialText, onSave, onClose, saving,
}: {
  initialText: string;
  onSave: (text: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  saving: boolean;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(initialText);
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1">添加快捷语</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">客服跟客户沟通时的参考话术，提交后进入审核流程</p>
        <textarea
          value={text}
          onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setText(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm leading-relaxed min-h-[120px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-400 focus:border-transparent"
          placeholder="输入快捷语话术，如：您好，这款马桶的坑距标准是305mm和400mm两种..."
        />
        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 font-medium hover:bg-gray-50">取消</button>

        </div>
      </div>

  );
});

/* ========== 共享类型 ========== */
interface EnhancementItem {
  id: string;
  company_id: string;
  module_key: string;
  section_index: number;
  item_index: number;
  quick_phrase: string | null;
  images: string[];
  source: string;
  custom_meaning: string | null;
  custom_title: string | null;
  is_hidden: boolean;
  review_status: string;
  reviewed_at: string | null;
  is_deleted: boolean;
}

/* ========== 模块组件共享Props ========== */
interface FeedbackStat { helpful: number; unhelpful: number; }

interface ModuleSharedProps {
  isAdminOrManager: boolean;
  enhancements: EnhancementItem[];
  getEnhancement: (moduleKey: string, sectionIndex: number, itemIndex: number) => EnhancementItem | null;
  feedbackStats: Record<string, FeedbackStat>;
  myFeedback: Record<string, string>;
  feedbackLoading: boolean;
  onFeedback: (moduleKey: string, sectionIndex: number, itemIndex: number, type: 'helpful' | 'unhelpful') => void;
  onSetCustomMeaningModal: (modal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string; title?: string; isNewItem?: boolean } | null) => void;
  onSetEditModal: (modal: { itemId: string; moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string } | null) => void;
  onSetDeleteConfirm: (confirm: { itemId: string } | null) => void;
  onSetNewModal: (modal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string } | null) => void;
  onSetImportModal: (modal: { moduleKey: string; json: string } | null) => void;
  onSetQuickPhraseModal: (modal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string } | null) => void;
  onSetImageUploadModal: (modal: { moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number } | null) => void;
  onSetImagePreview: (url: string | null) => void;
  onDeleteEnhancement: (id: string) => void;
  fetchEnhancements: () => void;
  authFetch: (input: string | URL | globalThis.Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;
}

/* ========== 辅助：审核状态标签 ========== */
function ReviewBadge({ status }: { status: string | undefined }) {
  if (!status) return null;
  const cls = status === 'pending' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'
    : status === 'approved' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700'
    : status === 'rejected' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
    : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-600';
  const label = status === 'pending' ? '待审核'
    : status === 'approved' ? '已采纳'
    : status === 'rejected' ? '已拒绝'
    : '自定义';
  return <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${cls}`}>{label}</span>;
}

/* ========== 辅助：来源+状态标签 ========== */
function SourceReviewBadge({ source, reviewStatus }: { source: string; reviewStatus?: string }) {
  if (source === 'platform') return <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-700">平台</span>;
  return reviewStatus ? <ReviewBadge status={reviewStatus} /> : null;
}

/* ========== 模块1：卫浴基础知识 ========== */
const WeiyuBasicsModule = memo(function WeiyuBasicsModule({
  isAdminOrManager, enhancements, feedbackStats, myFeedback, feedbackLoading, onFeedback,
  onSetCustomMeaningModal, fetchEnhancements, authFetch,
}: ModuleSharedProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {WEIYU_BASICS.map((section, si) => {
        const sectionEnhancements = enhancements.filter(e => e.module_key === 'weiyu-basics' && e.section_index === si);
        const hiddenItems = new Set(sectionEnhancements.filter(e => e.is_hidden).map(e => e.item_index));
        const customItems = sectionEnhancements.filter(e => e.custom_title && e.source === 'merchant');
        return (
          <div key={si}>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 text-base">{section.title}</h4>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {section.items.map((item, ii) => {
                if (hiddenItems.has(ii)) return null;
                const enh = sectionEnhancements.find(e => e.item_index === ii);
                const displayTitle = enh?.custom_title || item.title;
                const displayContent = enh?.custom_meaning || item.content;
                const reviewSt = enh?.custom_meaning ? enh.review_status as string | undefined : undefined;
                return (
                  <div key={ii} className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-gray-100">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 text-[15px]">{displayTitle}</span>
                          {reviewSt && <ReviewBadge status={reviewSt} />}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{displayContent}</div>
                      </div>
                      {isAdminOrManager && (
                        <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'weiyu-basics', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: displayContent })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors" title="编辑内容"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                          <button type="button" onClick={async () => { try { await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ module_key: 'weiyu-basics', section_index: si, item_index: ii, is_hidden: true, review_status: 'pending' }) }); await fetchEnhancements(); } catch(e) { /* ignore */ } }} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="隐藏条目"><EyeOff size={14} /></button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
                      <FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${si}-${ii}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('weiyu-basics', si, ii, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {customItems.map((enh) => (
                <div key={enh.id} className="bg-blue-50/50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-blue-100">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 text-[15px]">{enh.custom_title}</span>
                        <ReviewBadge status={enh.review_status as string | undefined} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{enh.custom_meaning || ''}</div>
                    </div>
                    {isAdminOrManager && (
                      <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'weiyu-basics', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: enh.item_index, text: enh.custom_meaning || '' })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors" title="编辑"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={async () => { try { await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ id: enh.id }) }); await fetchEnhancements(); } catch(e) { /* ignore */ } }} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="删除"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
                    <FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${enh.item_index}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${enh.item_index}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${si}-${enh.item_index}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('weiyu-basics', si, enh.item_index, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {isAdminOrManager && (
        <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'weiyu-basics', sectionIndex: WEIYU_BASICS.length, itemIndex: 0, text: '', isNewItem: true })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors text-[15px]"><Plus size={16} />添加知识条目</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {isAdminOrManager && enhancements.filter(e => e.module_key === 'weiyu-basics' && e.is_hidden).length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-4 border border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">已隐藏的条目（点击恢复显示）</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {enhancements.filter(e => e.module_key === 'weiyu-basics' && e.is_hidden).map(enh => (
              <button key={enh.id} type="button" onClick={async () => { try { await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ id: enh.id, module_key: 'weiyu-basics', section_index: enh.section_index, item_index: enh.item_index, is_hidden: false, review_status: 'pending' }) }); await fetchEnhancements(); } catch(e) { /* ignore */ } }} className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded text-sm text-gray-600 transition-colors"><Eye size={14} />恢复</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 模块2：全平台规则速查 ========== */
const PlatformRulesModule = memo(function PlatformRulesModule({

  customContent: CustomContentItem[];
  platformTab: PlatformKey;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {customContent && customContent.length > 0 ? (

            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{item.custom_title || ''}</span>

              </div>
              {isAdminOrManager && (
                <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetEditModal({ itemId: item.id, moduleKey: 'platform-rules', sectionIndex: item.section_index, itemIndex: item.item_index, title: item.custom_title || '', content: item.custom_content || '' })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-[#0F2B46] transition-colors" title="编辑"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetDeleteConfirm({ itemId: item.id })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="删除"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
              <FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${item.section_index}-${item.item_index}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${item.section_index}-${item.item_index}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${item.section_index}-${item.item_index}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('platform-rules', item.section_index, item.item_index, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} />
            </div>
          </div>
        ))
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            {(Object.keys(PLATFORM_RULES) as PlatformKey[]).map((key) => (
              <button key={key} type="button" onClick={() => setPlatformTab(key)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  platformTab === key ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 border border-transparent'
                }`}>
                {PLATFORM_RULES[key].label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-red-50">
                  <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold text-red-800 w-24">类别</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold text-red-800">⚠️ 红线禁令</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold text-red-800 w-36">违规后果</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold text-red-800 w-20">有用?</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {PLATFORM_RULES[platformTab].rules.map((rule, i) => (
                  <tr key={i} className={`border-b border-gray-100 ${rule.isWeiyu ? 'bg-amber-50/50' : ''}`}>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium text-gray-800">
                      {rule.category}
                      {rule.isWeiyu && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-amber-600 bg-amber-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded">卫浴</span>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-gray-700">{rule.ban}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-red-600 font-medium">{rule.consequence}</td>
                    <td className="px-2 py-2.5 text-center"><FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${({douyin:0,pinduoduo:1,jd:2,tmall:3} as Record<string,number>)[platformTab] ?? 0}-${i}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${({douyin:0,pinduoduo:1,jd:2,tmall:3} as Record<string,number>)[platformTab] ?? 0}-${i}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${({douyin:0,pinduoduo:1,jd:2,tmall:3} as Record<string,number>)[platformTab] ?? 0}-${i}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('platform-rules', ({douyin:0,pinduoduo:1,jd:2,tmall:3} as Record<string,number>)[platformTab] ?? 0, i, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 mt-3">
            <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-3 text-base">🧲 通用红线速记</h4>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {RED_LINE_REMINDERS.map((r, i) => (
                <div key={i} className={`flex items-start gap-2 text-base ${r.type === 'ban' ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-700'}`}>
                  <span className="shrink-0">{r.type === 'ban' ? '❌' : '✅'}</span>
                  <span className="flex-1">{r.text}</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0"><FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`99-${i}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`99-${i}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`99-${i}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('platform-rules', 99, i, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} /></span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {isAdminOrManager && <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetNewModal({ moduleKey: 'platform-rules', sectionIndex: 0, itemIndex: (customContent?.length || 0), title: '', content: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Plus size={16} />新增条目</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetImportModal({ moduleKey: 'platform-rules', json: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Upload size={16} />批量导入</button></div>}
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 模块4：售中工作细则 ========== */
const PresaleRulesModule = memo(function PresaleRulesModule({
  isAdminOrManager, enhancements, getEnhancement, customContent,
  onSetCustomMeaningModal, onSetQuickPhraseModal, onSetImageUploadModal, onSetImagePreview, onDeleteEnhancement,
  onSetNewModal, onSetImportModal, onSetEditModal, onSetDeleteConfirm,
  feedbackStats, myFeedback, feedbackLoading, onFeedback,
}: ModuleSharedProps & { customContent: CustomContentItem[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {customContent && customContent.length > 0 ? (
        customContent.map((item) => (
          <div key={item.id} className="bg-blue-50/50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-blue-100 relative">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{item.custom_title || ''}</span>
                  <SourceReviewBadge source={item.source} reviewStatus={item.review_status} />
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{item.custom_content || ''}</div>
              </div>
              {isAdminOrManager && (
                <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetEditModal({ itemId: item.id, moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: item.section_index, itemIndex: item.item_index, title: item.custom_title || '', content: item.custom_content || '' })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-[#0F2B46] transition-colors" title="编辑"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetDeleteConfirm({ itemId: item.id })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="删除"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))
      ) : (
        PRESALE_RULES.sections.map((section, si) => (
          <div key={si}>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 text-base">{section.title}</h4>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {(section.items as Record<string, string>[]).map((item, ii) => {
                const entries = Object.entries(item).filter(([k, v]) => v && k !== 'quick_phrase');
                const primary = entries[0]?.[1] || '';
                const secondary = entries[1]?.[1] || '';
                const isRuleField = 'rule' in item;
                const enh = getEnhancement('presale-rules', si, ii);
                const defaultQP = (item as Record<string, unknown>).quick_phrase as string | undefined;
                const isEditableTextSection = si === 0;
                const showEnhancements = ![0, 1, 4, 6].includes(si);
                return (
                  <div key={ii} className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-gray-100">
                    {isEditableTextSection ? (
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          {si === 0 ? (
                            <p className={`text-sm leading-relaxed font-medium ${enh?.custom_meaning ? 'text-gray-700' : 'text-red-600'}`}>{enh?.custom_meaning || primary}</p>
                          ) : (
                            <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-gray-700">{enh?.custom_meaning || primary}</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: enh?.custom_meaning || primary })} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-gray-300 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors rounded" title="修改文字"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                        {enh?.custom_meaning && enh.source === 'merchant' && <ReviewBadge status={enh.review_status as string | undefined} />}
                      </div>
                    ) : secondary ? (
                      <>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{primary}</span>
                        {si === 1 ? (
                          <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                            <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed flex-1">{enh?.custom_meaning || secondary}</span>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: enh?.custom_meaning || secondary })} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-gray-300 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors rounded" title="修改含义"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                            {enh?.custom_meaning && enh.source === 'merchant' && <ReviewBadge status={enh.review_status as string | undefined} />}
                          </div>
                        ) : [4, 6].includes(si) ? (
                          <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                            <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">{enh?.custom_meaning || secondary}</div>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetCustomMeaningModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: enh?.custom_meaning || secondary })} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-gray-300 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors rounded" title="修改文字"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                            {enh?.custom_meaning && enh.source === 'merchant' && <ReviewBadge status={enh.review_status as string | undefined} />}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          renderDetailText(secondary, 'text-sm text-gray-600 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed')
                        )}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      isRuleField
                        ? <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-red-600 font-medium">{primary}</p>
                        : renderDetailText(primary, 'text-sm leading-relaxed text-gray-700')
                    )}
                    {showEnhancements && (enh?.quick_phrase ? (
                      <div className="mt-2">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-2.5">
                          <MessageCircle size={16} className="shrink-0 text-green-600 mt-0.5" />
                          <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-green-800 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{enh.quick_phrase}</div>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetQuickPhraseModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: enh.quick_phrase || '' })} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-green-400 hover:text-green-700 transition-colors rounded" title="编辑话术"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(enh.quick_phrase || '').catch(() => {}); }} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-green-400 hover:text-green-700 transition-colors rounded" title="复制话术"><Copy size={13} /></button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5">
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-600">商家自定义</span>
                          {enh.source === 'merchant' && <ReviewBadge status={enh.review_status as string | undefined} />}
                          {enh.source === 'platform' && <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-700">平台</span>}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : defaultQP ? (
                      <div className="mt-2">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-2.5">
                          <MessageCircle size={16} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400 mt-0.5" />
                          <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{defaultQP}</div>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetQuickPhraseModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: defaultQP })} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors rounded" title="修改话术"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(defaultQP).catch(() => {}); }} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors rounded" title="复制参考话术"><Copy size={13} /></button>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 mt-1.5 inline-block">参考话术</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetQuickPhraseModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii, text: '' })} className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-green-700 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-green-100 transition-colors font-medium">
                        <MessageCircle size={12} />+ 快捷语
                      </button>
                    ))}
                    {showEnhancements && enh?.images && enh.images.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                        {enh.images.map((img, imgIdx) => (
                          <div key={imgIdx} className="relative group cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onSetImagePreview(img)}>
                            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                            <img src={img} alt={`示例图${imgIdx + 1}`} className="w-full h-20 object-cover rounded-lg border border-gray-200 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105" />
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {showEnhancements && (
                      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetImageUploadModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: si, itemIndex: ii })} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors font-medium">
                          <ImagePlus size={12} />+ 示例图
                        </button>
                        {enh && enh.source === 'merchant' && (
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onDeleteEnhancement(enh.id)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-red-600 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors font-medium">
                            <Trash2 size={12} />删除补充
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-end"><FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${si}-${ii}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('presale-rules', si, ii, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} /></div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))
      )}
      {isAdminOrManager && <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetNewModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', sectionIndex: 0, itemIndex: (customContent?.length || 0), title: '', content: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Plus size={16} />新增条目</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetImportModal({ moduleKey: 'presale-rules', json: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Upload size={16} />批量导入</button></div>}
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 模块5：售后工作手册 ========== */
const AftersaleFlowModule = memo(function AftersaleFlowModule({
  isAdminOrManager, customContent,
  onSetEditModal, onSetDeleteConfirm, onSetNewModal, onSetImportModal,
  feedbackStats, myFeedback, feedbackLoading, onFeedback,
  expandedBranches, toggleBranch, expandedItems, toggleItem,
}: ModuleSharedProps & {
  customContent: CustomContentItem[];
  expandedBranches: Record<string, boolean>;
  toggleBranch: (title: string) => void;
  expandedItems: Record<string, boolean>;
  toggleItem: (key: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {customContent && customContent.length > 0 ? (
        customContent.map((item) => (
          <div key={item.id} className="bg-blue-50/50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-blue-100 relative">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{item.custom_title || ''}</span>
                  <SourceReviewBadge source={item.source} reviewStatus={item.review_status} />
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{item.custom_content || ''}</div>
              </div>
              {isAdminOrManager && (
                <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetEditModal({ itemId: item.id, moduleKey: 'aftersale-flow', sectionIndex: item.section_index, itemIndex: item.item_index, title: item.custom_title || '', content: item.custom_content || '' })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-[#0F2B46] transition-colors" title="编辑"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSetDeleteConfirm({ itemId: item.id })} className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="删除"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))
      ) : (
        AFTERSALE_FLOW.map((section, si) => {
          const isBranch = (section as Record<string, unknown>).isBranch === true;
          const expanded = isBranch ? !!expandedBranches[section.title] : true;
          return (
            <div key={si} className={isBranch ? 'bg-blue-50 rounded-xl p-4 border-2 border-blue-200' : ''}>
              <h4
                className={`mb-3 ${isBranch ? 'text-lg font-extrabold text-blue-800 cursor-pointer select-none' : 'font-bold text-gray-900 text-base'}`}
                {...(isBranch ? { onClick: () => toggleBranch(section.title) } : {})}
              >
                {section.title}
                {isBranch && (
                  <>
                    <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 align-middle">分支流程</span>
                    <span className="ml-3 text-sm font-normal text-blue-500 align-middle">
                      {section.items.length}项内容，点击{expanded ? '收起' : '展开'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="ml-1 text-blue-500 align-middle inline-block transition-transform duration-200" style={{ transform: expanded ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)' }}>▼</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </h4>
              <div className={`space-y-2 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${expanded ? 'max-h-[5000px] opacity-100' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0'}`}>
                {(section.items as Record<string, string>[]).map((item, ii) => {
                  const name = item.name || item.rule || item.step || item.item || item.case || '';
                  const desc = item.desc || item.detail || item.result || item.check || '';
                  const itemKey = `${section.title}-${ii}`;
                  const itemExpanded = !!expandedItems[itemKey];
                  return (
                    <div key={ii} className={isBranch ? 'bg-white rounded-lg border border-blue-100 overflow-hidden' : 'bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 border border-gray-100'}>
                      {isBranch ? (
                        <>
                          <div
                            className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-blue-50/50 transition-colors"
                            onClick={() => toggleItem(itemKey)}
                          >
                            <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 text-sm">{name}</span>
                            {itemExpanded
                              ? <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                              : <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                            }
                          </div>
                          <div className={`overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${itemExpanded ? 'max-h-[5000px] opacity-100 px-3 pb-3' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0'}`}>
                            {desc && (isSOPContent(desc) ? renderSOPContent(desc) : renderDetailText(desc, `text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed`))}
                            {itemExpanded && <div className="mt-2 flex justify-end"><FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${si}-${ii}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('aftersale-flow', si, ii, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} /></div>}
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          {name && <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{name}</span>}
                          {desc && (isSOPContent(desc) ? renderSOPContent(desc) : renderDetailText(desc, `text-sm text-gray-600 leading-relaxed ${name ? 'mt-0.5' : ''}`))}
                          <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-end"><FeedbackButtons helpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.helpful) || 0} unhelpful={(feedbackStats[`${si}-${ii}`]?.unhelpful) || 0} myType={myFeedback[`${si}-${ii}`]} onFeedback={(type) => onFeedback('aftersale-flow', si, ii, type)} disabled={feedbackLoading} /></div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
      {isAdminOrManager && <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetNewModal({ moduleKey: 'aftersale-flow', sectionIndex: 0, itemIndex: (customContent?.length || 0), title: '', content: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Plus size={16} />新增条目</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onSetImportModal({ moduleKey: 'aftersale-flow', json: '' })} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors"><Upload size={16} />批量导入</button></div>}
    </div>
  );
});

/* ========== 主页面 ========== */
export default function NewbieTrainingPage() {
  const { profile, authFetch } = useAuth();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const moduleParam = searchParams.get('module');
  const [platformTab, setPlatformTab] = useState<PlatformKey>('douyin');
  const [progressMap, setProgressMap] = useState<Record<string, ModuleStatus>>({});
  const [teamData, setTeamData] = useState<{ members: { id: string; display_name: string; role: string }[]; progress: ProgressItem[] } | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [confirmDialog, setConfirmDialog] = useState<{ open: boolean; title: string; message: string; confirmLabel: string; onConfirm: () => void } | null>(null);
  const [showGuide, setShowGuide] = useState(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);
  const [expandedBranches, setExpandedBranches] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [expandedItems, setExpandedItems] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [customContent, setCustomContent] = useState<Record<string, CustomContentItem[]>>({});

  // Item enhancements (快捷语 + 示例图)
  const [enhancements, setEnhancements] = useState<EnhancementItem[]>([]);
  const [accessoryGallery, setAccessoryGallery] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; image_url: string | null; is_default: boolean; source: string; company_id: string }[]>([]);
