  // 快捷语编辑弹窗
  const [quickPhraseModal, setQuickPhraseModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string } | null>(null);
  // 示例图上传弹窗
  const [imageUploadModal, setImageUploadModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number } | null>(null);
  // 图片预览
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // 自定义含义编辑弹窗
  const [customMeaningModal, setCustomMeaningModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; text: string; title?: string; isNewItem?: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  // 编辑/新增/删除/导入弹窗状态
  const [editModal, setEditModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string; itemId?: string } | null>(null);
  const [newModal, setNewModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; sectionIndex: number; itemIndex: number; title: string; content: string } | null>(null);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<{ itemId: string } | null>(null);
  const [importModal, setImportModal] = useState<{ moduleKey: string; json: string } | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // 管理员审核状态
  const [reviewItems, setReviewItems] = useState<Array<CustomContentItem & { company_name?: string }>>([]);
  const [showReviewPanel, setShowReviewPanel] = useState(false);
  const [reviewLoading, setReviewLoading] = useState(false);

  // 👍👎 反馈状态
  const [feedbackStats, setFeedbackStats] = useState<Record<string, { helpful: number; unhelpful: number }>>({});
  const [myFeedback, setMyFeedback] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [feedbackLoading, setFeedbackLoading] = useState(false);

  // 获取自定义内容
  const fetchCustomContent = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training');
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const grouped: Record<string, CustomContentItem[]> = {};
        for (const item of data) {
          if (!grouped[item.module_key]) grouped[item.module_key] = [];
          grouped[item.module_key].push(item);
        }
        setCustomContent(grouped);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchCustomContent(); }, [fetchCustomContent]);

  // 获取item enhancements
  const fetchEnhancements = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements');
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setEnhancements(data.data || []);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchEnhancements(); }, [fetchEnhancements]);

  // ===== 配件图鉴 =====

  const fetchAccessories = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery');
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setAccessoryGallery(data.data || []);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchAccessories(); }, [fetchAccessories]);

  // ===== 👍👎 反馈 =====
  const fetchFeedback = useCallback(async (moduleKey: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch(`/api/item-feedback?moduleKey=${moduleKey}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setFeedbackStats(data.stats || {});
        setMyFeedback(data.myFeedback || {});
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  const handleFeedback = useCallback(async (moduleKey: string, sectionIndex: number, itemIndex: number, feedbackType: 'helpful' | 'unhelpful') => {
    try {
      const key = `${sectionIndex}-${itemIndex}`;
      // 已反馈同类型则取消，已反馈不同类型则切换
      if (myFeedback[key] === feedbackType) return;
      setFeedbackLoading(true);
      const res = await authFetch('/api/item-feedback', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ moduleKey, sectionIndex, itemIndex, feedbackType }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        // 乐观更新
        const prevType = myFeedback[key];
        setMyFeedback(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: feedbackType }));
        setFeedbackStats(prev => {
          const stat = { ...(prev[key] || { helpful: 0, unhelpful: 0 }) };
          if (prevType === 'helpful') stat.helpful = Math.max(0, stat.helpful - 1);
          if (prevType === 'unhelpful') stat.unhelpful = Math.max(0, stat.unhelpful - 1);
          if (feedbackType === 'helpful') stat.helpful++;
          else stat.unhelpful++;
          return { ...prev, [key]: stat };
        });
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setFeedbackLoading(false);
  }, [myFeedback]);

  // 渲染反馈按钮的辅助函数

  const handleUploadAccessoryImage = async (accessoryId: string, file: File) => {
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('accessoryId', accessoryId);
      const res = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery/upload-image', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchAccessories();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: '上传失败' }));
        alert(err.error || '图片上传失败');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('上传图片异常:', e);
      alert('图片上传异常，请重试');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAccessory = async (accessoryId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('确定删除此配件？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: accessoryId }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchAccessories();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: '删除失败' }));
        alert(err.error || '删除配件失败');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('删除配件异常:', e);
      alert('删除配件异常，请重试');
    }
  };

  const handleRenameAccessory = async (accessoryId: string, newName: string) => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: accessoryId, name: newName.trim() }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchAccessories();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: '重命名失败' }));
        alert(err.error || '重命名失败');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('重命名配件异常:', e);
      alert('重命名异常，请重试');
    }
  };

  const handleAddAccessory = async (name: string, file: File | null) => {
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    try {
      let imageUrl: string | null = null;

      // 如果有图片，先上传到 Storage 拿到 URL
      if (file) {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        const uploadRes = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery/upload-image', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });
        if (uploadRes.ok) {
          const uploadData = await uploadRes.json();
          imageUrl = uploadData.url || null;
        } else {
          const err = await uploadRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
          console.error('上传配件图片失败:', err);
          // 图片上传失败仍可创建配件，只是没有图片
        }
      }

      // 创建配件记录（含图片URL）
      const res = await authFetch('/api/accessory-gallery', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: name.trim(), image_url: imageUrl }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchAccessories();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        console.error('添加配件失败:', err);
        alert(err.error || '添加配件失败，请重试');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('添加配件异常:', e);
      alert('网络异常，请重试');
    }
  };

  // 获取某个item的enhancement（merchant优先于platform）—— O(1) 查找
  const enhancementMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, EnhancementItem> = {};
    for (const e of enhancements) {
      // merchant 优先：如果已有 merchant 记录就覆盖 platform 记录
      const key = `${e.module_key}:${e.section_index}:${e.item_index}`;
      const existing = map[key];
      if (!existing || e.source === 'merchant') {
        map[key] = e;
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [enhancements]);

  const getEnhancement = useCallback((moduleKey: string, sectionIndex: number, itemIndex: number): EnhancementItem | null => {
    return enhancementMap[`${moduleKey}:${sectionIndex}:${itemIndex}`] || null;
  }, [enhancementMap]);

  // 稳定关闭回调，避免子组件不必要的重渲染
  const closeEditModal = useCallback(() => setEditModal(null), []);
  const closeNewModal = useCallback(() => setNewModal(null), []);
  const closeImportModal = useCallback(() => setImportModal(null), []);
  const closeDeleteConfirm = useCallback(() => setDeleteConfirm(null), []);
  const closeQuickPhraseModal = useCallback(() => setQuickPhraseModal(null), []);
  const closeImageUploadModal = useCallback(() => setImageUploadModal(null), []);
  const closeCustomMeaningModal = useCallback(() => setCustomMeaningModal(null), []);

  // 保存快捷语
  const handleSaveQuickPhrase = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    if (!quickPhraseModal) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          module_key: quickPhraseModal.moduleKey,
          section_index: quickPhraseModal.sectionIndex,
          item_index: quickPhraseModal.itemIndex,
          quick_phrase: text,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setQuickPhraseModal(null);
        await fetchEnhancements();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [quickPhraseModal, fetchEnhancements]);

  // 保存自定义含义
  const handleSaveCustomMeaning = useCallback(async (text: string, title?: string) => {
    if (!customMeaningModal) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        module_key: customMeaningModal.moduleKey,
        section_index: customMeaningModal.sectionIndex,
        item_index: customMeaningModal.itemIndex,
        custom_meaning: text,
      };
      if (title !== undefined) {
        body.custom_title = title;
      }
      if (customMeaningModal.isNewItem) {
        body.custom_title = title || '';
        body.is_hidden = false;
      }
      const res = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setCustomMeaningModal(null);
        await fetchEnhancements();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [customMeaningModal, fetchEnhancements]);

  // 上传示例图
  const handleUploadImage = useCallback(async (file: File) => {
    if (!imageUploadModal) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('module_key', imageUploadModal.moduleKey);
      formData.append('section_index', String(imageUploadModal.sectionIndex));
      formData.append('item_index', String(imageUploadModal.itemIndex));
      const uploadRes = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements/upload-image', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
      if (uploadRes.ok) {
        const { url } = await uploadRes.json();
        // Now save to enhancement record
        const existing = getEnhancement(imageUploadModal.moduleKey, imageUploadModal.sectionIndex, imageUploadModal.itemIndex);
        const currentImages = existing?.images || [];
        const newImages = [...currentImages, url];
        const res = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            module_key: imageUploadModal.moduleKey,
            section_index: imageUploadModal.sectionIndex,
            item_index: imageUploadModal.itemIndex,
            images: newImages,
          }),
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          setImageUploadModal(null);
          await fetchEnhancements();
        } else {
          const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          console.error('保存示例图失败:', err);
          alert(err.error || '保存示例图失败，请重试');
        }
      } else {
        const err = await uploadRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        console.error('上传图片失败:', err);
        alert(err.error || '上传图片失败，请重试');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('上传异常:', e);
      alert('上传异常，请重试');
    }
    setUploading(false);
  }, [imageUploadModal, getEnhancement, fetchEnhancements]);

  // 删除enhancement
  const handleDeleteEnhancement = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/item-enhancements', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchEnhancements();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, [fetchEnhancements]);

  // 管理员获取待审核内容
  const fetchReviewItems = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setReviewLoading(true);
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training/review');
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setReviewItems(data.data || []);
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setReviewLoading(false);
  }, []);

  // 管理员审核操作
  const handleReviewAction = useCallback(async (itemId: string, action: 'approve' | 'reject') => {
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training/review', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ item_id: itemId, action }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setReviewItems(prev => prev.filter(item => item.id !== itemId));
        await fetchCustomContent();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, [fetchCustomContent]);

  // 编辑保存
  const handleSaveEdit = useCallback(async (title: string, content: string) => {
    if (!editModal) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          id: editModal.itemId,
          module_key: editModal.moduleKey,
          section_index: editModal.sectionIndex,
          item_index: editModal.itemIndex,
          custom_title: title,
          custom_content: content,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setEditModal(null);
        await fetchCustomContent();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [editModal, fetchCustomContent]);

  // 新增保存
  const handleSaveNew = useCallback(async (title: string, content: string) => {
    if (!newModal) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          module_key: newModal.moduleKey,
          section_index: newModal.sectionIndex,
          item_index: newModal.itemIndex,
          custom_title: title,
          custom_content: content,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setNewModal(null);
        await fetchCustomContent();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [newModal, fetchCustomContent]);

  // 删除确认
  const handleDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!deleteConfirm) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await authFetch('/api/custom-training', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: deleteConfirm.itemId }),
      });
      setDeleteConfirm(null);
      await fetchCustomContent();
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [deleteConfirm, fetchCustomContent]);

  // 批量导入
  const handleImport = useCallback(async (json: string) => {
    if (!importModal) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      let items: { module_key: string; section_index: number; item_index: number; custom_title: string; custom_content: string }[] = [];
      try {
        items = JSON.parse(json);
      } catch { alert('JSON格式错误，请检查'); setSaving(false); return; }
      if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) { alert('请输入有效的JSON数组'); setSaving(false); return; }
      const res = await authFetch('/api/custom-training/import', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ items, module_key: importModal.moduleKey }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setImportModal(null);
        await fetchCustomContent();
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    setSaving(false);
  }, [importModal, fetchCustomContent]);

  const toggleBranch = (title: string) => {
    setExpandedBranches(prev => ({ ...prev, [title]: !prev[title] }));
  };

  const toggleItem = (key: string) => {
    setExpandedItems(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: !prev[key] }));
  };

  // 首次进入引导检测
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !localStorage.getItem('newbie-training-guided')) {
      setShowGuide(true);
    }
  }, []);

  // 从URL参数推导当前激活模块
  const activeNav = useMemo(() => {
    if (!moduleParam) return 'overview';
    if (moduleParam === 'team-progress') return 'team-progress';
    const idx = parseInt(moduleParam, 10);
    if (idx >= 1 && idx <= MODULE_IDS.length) return MODULE_IDS[idx - 1];
    return 'overview';
  }, [moduleParam]);

  // 切换模块时加载反馈数据
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeNav && activeNav !== 'overview' && activeNav !== 'team-progress') {
      fetchFeedback(activeNav);
    }
  }, [activeNav, fetchFeedback]);

  // 导航切换：更新URL参数
  const navigateTo = useCallback((key: string) => {
    if (key === 'overview') {
      router.push('/newbie-training');
    } else if (key === 'team-progress') {
      router.push('/newbie-training?module=team-progress');
    } else {
      const idx = MODULE_IDS.indexOf(key);
      if (idx >= 0) router.push(`/newbie-training?module=${idx + 1}`);
    }
  }, [router]);

  const role = profile?.role || '';
  const isAdminOrManager = ['admin', 'enterprise_admin', 'enterprise_manager'].includes(role);

  // 加载自己的进度
  const fetchProgress = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(false);
    authFetch('/api/newbie-training/progress')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data.progress) {
          const map: Record<string, ModuleStatus> = {};
          (data.progress as ProgressItem[]).forEach((p: ProgressItem) => {
            map[p.module_id] = p.status as ModuleStatus;
          });
          setProgressMap(map);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => { setLoadError(true); })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchProgress(); }, [fetchProgress]);

  // 管理员加载团队进度
  const fetchTeamProgress = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isAdminOrManager) return;
    authFetch('/api/newbie-training/team-progress')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => { if (data.members) setTeamData(data); })
      .catch(() => { setLoadError(true); });
  }, [isAdminOrManager]);

  useEffect(() => { fetchTeamProgress(); }, [fetchTeamProgress]);

  const updateStatus = useCallback(async (moduleId: string, status: ModuleStatus) => {
    setProgressMap(prev => ({ ...prev, [moduleId]: status }));
    authFetch('/api/newbie-training/progress', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ moduleId, status }),
    }).catch(() => {});
    // Day2: 完成新人培训入门 → 完成
    markOnboardingDay(authFetch, 2);
  }, [authFetch]);

  const confirmUpdateStatus = useCallback((moduleId: string, status: ModuleStatus, title: string, message: string, confirmLabel: string) => {
    setConfirmDialog({ open: true, title, message, confirmLabel, onConfirm: () => { updateStatus(moduleId, status); setConfirmDialog(null); } });
  }, [updateStatus]);

  const handleQuickLink = (target: string) => {
    if (target.startsWith('/')) {
      window.location.href = target;
    } else {
      navigateTo(target);
    }
  };

  const getStatus = (moduleId: string): ModuleStatus => progressMap[moduleId] || 'not_started';

  const handleRetry = () => {
    fetchProgress();
    fetchTeamProgress();
  };

  // 计算团队统计
  const teamStats = teamData ? (() => {
    const { members, progress } = teamData;
    const progressByUser: Record<string, Record<string, ModuleStatus>> = {};
    progress.forEach((p: ProgressItem) => {
      if (!progressByUser[p.module_id]) progressByUser[p.module_id] = {};
      if (p.user_id) progressByUser[p.module_id][p.user_id] = p.status as ModuleStatus;
    });
    const completedCount = (userId: string) => MODULE_IDS.filter(id => progressByUser[id]?.[userId] === 'completed').length;
    const notStarted = members.filter(m => completedCount(m.id) === 0);
    const inProgress = members.filter(m => { const c = completedCount(m.id); return c > 0 && c < 9; });
    const allDone = members.filter(m => completedCount(m.id) === 9);
    return { total: members.length, notStarted, inProgress, allDone, completedCount };
  })() : null;

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20"><div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-sky-500" /></div>;
  }

  // 已完成模块数
  const completedModules = MODULE_IDS.filter(id => getStatus(id) === 'completed').length;
  const totalModules = MODULE_IDS.length;
  const overallPct = Math.round((completedModules / totalModules) * 100);

  return (
    <>
    <div className="animate-fade-in-up">
      {/* ====== 加载失败提示 ====== */}
      {loadError && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500 shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-base text-red-700 font-medium">数据加载失败，请刷新重试</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRetry}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 text-white font-semibold text-sm hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors shrink-0"
          >
            重新加载
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* ====== 管理员审核入口 ====== */}
      {role === 'admin' && (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setShowReviewPanel(!showReviewPanel); if (!showReviewPanel) fetchReviewItems(); }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-100 transition-colors w-full"
          >
            <ShieldCheck size={18} className="text-amber-600" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">待审核内容</span>
            <span className="ml-auto text-xs bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">
              {reviewItems.length > 0 ? `${reviewItems.length} 条` : '无'}
            </span>
            <ChevronDown size={16} className={`transition-transform ${showReviewPanel ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
          </button>
          {showReviewPanel && (
            <div className="mt-2 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl bg-white overflow-hidden">
              {reviewLoading ? (
                <div className="p-6 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">加载中...</div>
              ) : reviewItems.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-6 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">暂无待审核内容</div>
              ) : (
                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
                  {reviewItems.map((item) => (
                    <div key={item.id} className="p-4 hover:bg-gray-50">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                            <span className="text-xs bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium">{item.module_key}</span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{item.company_name}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{item.custom_title || '(无标题)'}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1 line-clamp-2 whitespace-pre-line">{item.custom_content || '(无内容)'}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 shrink-0">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewAction(item.id, 'approve')}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 transition-colors"
                          >
                            采纳
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewAction(item.id, 'reject')}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition-colors"
                          >
                            拒绝
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* ====== 内容区 ====== */}
      <main className="min-w-0 overflow-y-auto pb-20">
        {/* ====== 学习地图总览 ====== */}
        {activeNav === 'overview' && (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            {/* 标题区 */}
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900">学习地图</h1>
              <p className="text-base text-gray-500 mt-1">9大模块，从入职到上手全流程自助学习</p>
            </div>

            {/* 总进度卡片 */}
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0F2B46] to-[#1a3a5c] rounded-xl p-5 text-white">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-300" />
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">我的学习进度</span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-2xl font-bold">{overallPct}%</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full bg-white/20 rounded-full h-2.5">
                <div className="bg-sky-400 h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-500" style={{ width: `${overallPct}%` }} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-4 mt-3 text-sm">
                <span className="text-white/60">已完成 <span className="text-green-400 font-semibold">{completedModules}</span></span>
                <span className="text-white/60">学习中 <span className="text-sky-300 font-semibold">{MODULE_IDS.filter(id => getStatus(id) === 'in_progress').length}</span></span>
                <span className="text-white/60">未开始 <span className="font-semibold">{MODULE_IDS.filter(id => getStatus(id) === 'not_started').length}</span></span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 管理员团队概览卡片 */}
            {isAdminOrManager && teamData && teamStats && (
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-500" />
                    <span className="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900">团队学习概况</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => navigateTo('team-progress')}
                    className="text-sm text-sky-600 hover:text-sky-700 font-medium"
                  >
                    查看详情 →
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <div className="text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50">
                    <div className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-400">{teamStats.notStarted.length}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">未开始</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-sky-50">
                    <div className="text-xl font-bold text-sky-500">{teamStats.inProgress.length}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">学习中</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-50">
                    <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-500">{teamStats.allDone.length}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">已完成</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {teamStats.notStarted.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-red-600 bg-red-50 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{teamStats.notStarted.length}人尚未开始学习，需要催办</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 学习引导提示 */}
            <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className="text-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">📌</span>
              <p className="text-base text-blue-900 font-medium leading-relaxed">
                从模块1开始，按顺序学习，{MODULE_IDS.length}个模块全部完成即通过新人考核
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 9模块卡片网格 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {NAV_ITEMS.filter(n => n.key !== 'overview').map((item, idx) => {
                const Icon = item.icon;
                const status = getStatus(item.key);
                const sc = STATUS_CONFIG[status];
                return (
                  <button
                    key={item.key}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => navigateTo(item.key)}
                    className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-4 text-left hover:shadow-md hover:border-sky-200 transition-all group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                      <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${item.iconColor}`}>
                        <Icon className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">模块{idx + 1}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">{item.label}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${sc.bgColor}`}>
                        {sc.icon} {sc.label}
                      </span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-300 group-hover:text-sky-500 transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* 内容更新提示 */}
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">💡 培训内容持续更新中，建议定期回来查看新内容</p>

            {/* 快捷入口 */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">快捷入口</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {QUICK_LINKS.map((link) => {
                  const Icon = link.icon;
                  return (
                    <button key={link.label} type="button" onClick={() => handleQuickLink(link.target)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer">
                      <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center ${link.color}`}>
                        <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{link.label}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ====== 模块详情页：统一模板 ====== */}
        {activeNav !== 'overview' && activeNav !== 'team-progress' && (() => {
          const moduleIdx = MODULE_IDS.indexOf(activeNav);
          const navItem = NAV_ITEMS.find(n => n.key === activeNav);
          if (moduleIdx < 0 || !navItem) return null;
          const status = getStatus(activeNav);
          const sc = STATUS_CONFIG[status];
          const ModuleIcon = navItem.icon;
          return (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              {/* 模块头部：标题+状态+标记按钮 */}
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center ${navItem.iconColor}`}>
                    <ModuleIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">模块{moduleIdx + 1}</span>
                      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${sc.bgColor}`}>
                        {sc.icon} {sc.label}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">{navItem.label}</h2>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {status !== 'completed' && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => confirmUpdateStatus(activeNav, 'completed', '确认完成', '确认已完成本模块学习？', '确认完成')}
                        className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-500 text-blue-950 font-semibold text-sm transition-colors"
                      >
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1" />
                        标记完成
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {status === 'not_started' && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => updateStatus(activeNav, 'in_progress')}
                        className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-medium text-sm transition-colors"
                      >
                        开始学习
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {status === 'completed' && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-green-50 text-green-700">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 已完成
                        </span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => confirmUpdateStatus(activeNav, 'in_progress', '撤销完成', '确认撤销完成状态？', '确认撤销')}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors"
                        >
                          撤销完成
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 模块内容 */}
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-5">
                {activeNav === 'weiyu-basics' && (
                  <WeiyuBasicsModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'platform-rules' && (
                  <PlatformRulesModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['platform-rules'] || []}
                    platformTab={platformTab}
                    setPlatformTab={setPlatformTab}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'system-guide' && (
                  <SystemGuideModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['system-guide'] || []}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'presale-rules' && (
                  <PresaleRulesModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['presale-rules'] || []}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'accessory-gallery' && (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div className="mb-4">
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">特殊配件图鉴</h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">常见配件实物参考，点击上传您公司的配件图片</p>
                    </div>
                    <AccessoryGallerySection
                      accessories={accessoryGallery}
                      onUpload={handleUploadAccessoryImage}
                      onDelete={handleDeleteAccessory}
                      onAdd={handleAddAccessory}
                      onRename={handleRenameAccessory}
                      isAdmin={isAdminOrManager}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                {activeNav === 'aftersale-flow' && (
                  <AftersaleFlowModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['aftersale-flow'] || []}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    expandedBranches={expandedBranches}
                    toggleBranch={toggleBranch}
                    expandedItems={expandedItems}
                    toggleItem={toggleItem}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'quick-phrases' && (
                  <QuickPhrasesModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['quick-phrases'] || []}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}

                {activeNav === 'assessment' && (
                  <AssessmentModule
                    isAdminOrManager={isAdminOrManager}
                    enhancements={enhancements}
                    getEnhancement={getEnhancement}
                    customContent={customContent['assessment'] || []}
                    feedbackStats={feedbackStats}
                    myFeedback={myFeedback}
                    feedbackLoading={feedbackLoading}
                    onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                    onSetCustomMeaningModal={setCustomMeaningModal}
                    onSetEditModal={setEditModal}
                    onSetDeleteConfirm={setDeleteConfirm}
                    onSetNewModal={setNewModal}
                    onSetImportModal={setImportModal}
                    onSetQuickPhraseModal={setQuickPhraseModal}
                    onSetImageUploadModal={setImageUploadModal}
                    onSetImagePreview={setImagePreview}
                    onDeleteEnhancement={handleDeleteEnhancement}
                    fetchEnhancements={fetchEnhancements}
                    authFetch={authFetch}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })()}

        {/* ====== 团队进度管理面板 ====== */}
        {activeNav === 'team-progress' && isAdminOrManager && teamData && teamStats && (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900">团队进度</h1>
              <p className="text-base text-gray-500 mt-1">管理面板 · 查看下属学习情况</p>
            </div>

            {/* 进度统计卡片 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-4 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-400">{teamStats.notStarted.length}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">未开始</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-sky-200 shadow-sm p-4 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-sky-500">{teamStats.inProgress.length}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">学习中</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-green-200 shadow-sm p-4 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-500">{teamStats.allDone.length}</div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">已完成</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 成员列表 */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
              <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900">团队成员 ({teamStats.total}人)</h3>
                <button type="button" className="text-sm text-sky-600 hover:text-sky-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Bell className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 一键催办
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {teamData.members.map(m => {
                  const done = teamStats.completedCount(m.id);
                  const pct = Math.round((done / 9) * 100);
                  const isLate = done === 0;
                  return (
                    <div key={m.id} className={`flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-3 ${isLate ? 'bg-red-50/50' : ''}`}>
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold shrink-0">
                        {(m.display_name || '未')[0]}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 truncate">{m.display_name || '未命名'}</span>
                          {isLate && <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-600 font-medium">超期预警</span>}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-1.5">
                          <div className="bg-sky-400 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 shrink-0">{done}/9 模块</span>
                      <button type="button" className="shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 hover:bg-sky-50 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors text-gray-400" title="催办">
                        <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 预警列表 */}
            {teamStats.notStarted.length > 0 && (
              <div className="bg-red-50 rounded-xl border border-red-200 p-5">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-red-800 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" /> 超期预警
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {teamStats.notStarted.map(m => (
                    <div key={m.id} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 border border-red-100">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{m.display_name || '未命名'}</span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-red-600 font-medium">0/9 模块 · 尚未开始学习</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 团队进度 - 无数据提示 */}
        {activeNav === 'team-progress' && (!teamData || !teamStats) && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-gray-400">
            <Users className="w-12 h-12 mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium">暂无团队数据</p>
            <p className="text-sm">团队成员的学习进度将在这里展示</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* ====== 确认操作弹窗 ====== */}
      {confirmDialog && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40" onClick={() => setConfirmDialog(null)}>
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-6 mx-4 max-w-sm w-full" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">{confirmDialog.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-base text-gray-600 mb-5 leading-relaxed">{confirmDialog.message}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmDialog(null)}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 font-medium text-base hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors"
              >
                取消
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={confirmDialog.onConfirm}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0F2B46] text-white font-semibold text-base hover:bg-[#1a3a5c] transition-colors"
              >
                {confirmDialog.confirmLabel}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ====== 首次进入引导弹窗 ====== */}
      {showGuide && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-6 mx-4 max-w-sm w-full text-center">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-sky-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <GraduationCap className="w-7 h-7 text-sky-600" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3">欢迎来到新人培训 🎉</h3>
            <p className="text-base text-gray-600 leading-relaxed mb-5">
              9大模块涵盖卫浴产品知识、平台规则、售中售后流程、话术技巧和考核标准，按顺序学完即可上岗。主管可随时查看你的学习进度。
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setShowGuide(false); localStorage.setItem('newbie-training-guided', '1'); }}
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0F2B46] text-white font-bold text-base hover:bg-[#1a3a5c] transition-colors"
            >
              开始学习
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
    {/* ===== 弹窗区域（Portal到body，避免transform影响fixed定位） ===== */}
    <ModalPortal>
      {/* ===== 编辑弹窗 ===== */}
      {editModal && (
        <EditModal
          initialTitle={editModal.title}
          initialContent={editModal.content}
          onSave={handleSaveEdit}
          onClose={closeEditModal}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 新增弹窗 ===== */}
      {newModal && (
        <NewModal
          onSave={handleSaveNew}
          onClose={closeNewModal}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 导入弹窗 ===== */}
      {importModal && (
        <ImportModal
          onImport={handleImport}
          onClose={closeImportModal}
        />
      )}

      {/* ===== 删除确认弹窗 ===== */}
      {deleteConfirm && (
        <DeleteConfirmModal
          onConfirm={handleDelete}
          onClose={closeDeleteConfirm}
        />
      )}

      {/* 快捷语编辑弹窗 */}
      {quickPhraseModal && (
        <QuickPhraseModal
          initialText={quickPhraseModal.text}
          onSave={handleSaveQuickPhrase}
          onClose={closeQuickPhraseModal}
          saving={saving}
        />
      )}

      {/* 示例图上传弹窗 */}
      {imageUploadModal && (
        <ImageUploadModal
          onUpload={handleUploadImage}
          onClose={closeImageUploadModal}
          uploading={uploading}
        />
      )}

      {/* 自定义含义编辑弹窗 */}
      {customMeaningModal && (
        <CustomMeaningModal
          initialText={customMeaningModal.text}
          initialTitle={customMeaningModal.title}
          isNewItem={customMeaningModal.isNewItem}
          moduleKey={customMeaningModal.moduleKey}
          onSave={handleSaveCustomMeaning}
          onClose={closeCustomMeaningModal}
        />
      )}

      {/* 图片大图预览 */}
      {imagePreview && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" onClick={() => setImagePreview(null)}>
          <div className="relative max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh]" onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img src={imagePreview} alt="预览" className="max-w-full max-h-[85vh] object-contain rounded-lg" />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setImagePreview(null)} className="absolute -top-3 -right-3 w-8 h-8 bg-white rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900">
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </ModalPortal>
    </>
  );
}

// ===== src/app/(main)/notifications/page.tsx =====
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/auth-context';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Bell,
  TrendingUp,
  ScrollText,
  Target,
  BellRing,
  CheckCheck,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Clock,
  X,
  BarChart3,
  Wrench,
  ThumbsUp,
  ThumbsDown,
} from 'lucide-react';

/* ─── Types ─── */
interface Notification {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  title: string;
  summary: string | null;
  content: string | null;
  is_read: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  company_id: string | null;
}

type TabKey = 'all' | 'industry_trend' | 'platform_rule' | 'daily_case' | 'product_update' | 'work_order' | 'review';

/* ─── Type config ─── */
const TYPE_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; color: string; bgColor: string; borderColor: string }> = {
  industry_trend: {
    label: '行业趋势',
    icon: <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-blue-700',
    bgColor: 'bg-blue-50',
    borderColor: 'border-blue-200',
  },
  platform_rule: {
    label: '规则变动',
    icon: <ScrollText className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-blue-950',
    bgColor: 'bg-sky-50',
    borderColor: 'border-sky-100',
  },
  daily_case: {
    label: '今日场景',
    icon: <Target className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-green-700',
    bgColor: 'bg-green-50',
    borderColor: 'border-green-200',
  },
  product_update: {
    label: '产品更新',
    icon: <BellRing className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-gray-700',
    bgColor: 'bg-gray-50',
    borderColor: 'border-gray-200',
  },
  work_order: {
    label: '工单提醒',
    icon: <Wrench className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-blue-900',
    bgColor: 'bg-slate-50',
    borderColor: 'border-slate-200',
  },
  review: {
    label: '复盘提醒',
    icon: <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />,
    color: 'text-purple-700',
    bgColor: 'bg-purple-50',
    borderColor: 'border-purple-200',
  },
};

const TABS: { key: TabKey; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部', icon: <Bell className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'industry_trend', label: '行业趋势', icon: <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'platform_rule', label: '规则变动', icon: <ScrollText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'daily_case', label: '今日场景', icon: <Target className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'product_update', label: '产品更新', icon: <BellRing className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'work_order', label: '工单提醒', icon: <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  { key: 'review', label: '复盘提醒', icon: <BarChart3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
];

/* ─── Helper: format relative time ─── */
function formatTime(dateStr: string): string {
  const date = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  if (diffMin < 1) return '刚刚';
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}分钟前`;
  const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  if (diffHour < 24) return `${diffHour}小时前`;
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay}天前`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

/* ─── Main Page ─── */
export default function NotificationsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { profile, authFetch } = useAuth();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('all');
  const [reviewSubFilter, setReviewSubFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [workOrderSubFilter, setWorkOrderSubFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [expandedWorkOrderId, setExpandedWorkOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [workOrders, setWorkOrders] = useState<Array<{
    id: string; customer_name: string; query: string; category: string;
    ai_judgment: string; ai_script: string; priority: string; status: string;
    result: string; created_at: string; completed_at: string | null;
  }>>([]);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedNotification, setSelectedNotification] = useState<Notification | null>(null);
  const fetchedRef = useRef(false);
  const [myFeedback, setMyFeedback] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  // Fetch notifications
  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!profile?.companyId) return;
    try {
      if (activeTab === 'work_order') {
        // 获取工单数据
        const res = await authFetch(`/api/work-orders?role=${profile.role}&companyId=${profile.companyId}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          setWorkOrders(data.data || []);
        }
        setNotifications([]);
      } else {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ company_id: profile.companyId });
        if (activeTab !== 'all') params.set('type', activeTab);
        const res = await authFetch(`/api/notifications?${params}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          setNotifications(data.data || []);
          // Fetch feedback status for loaded notifications
          const ids = (data.data || []).map((n: Notification) => n.id);
          if (ids.length > 0) {
            try {
              const fbRes = await authFetch(`/api/notification-feedback?notification_ids=${ids.join(',')}`);
              if (fbRes.ok) {
                const fbData = await fbRes.json();
                setMyFeedback(fbData.myFeedback || {});
              }
            } catch { /* ignore */ }
          }
        }
        setWorkOrders([]);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [profile?.companyId, profile?.role, activeTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile?.companyId) return;
    fetchedRef.current = false;
    setLoading(true);
    fetchNotifications();
  }, [profile?.companyId, activeTab, fetchNotifications]);

  // Notify app-shell to refresh unread count
  const notifyUnreadChange = useCallback(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('notifications-read'));
    }
  }, []);

  // Mark as read (single)
  const markAsRead = useCallback(async (notification: Notification) => {
    if (notification.is_read) return;
    setNotifications(prev =>
      prev.map(n => n.id === notification.id ? { ...n, is_read: true } : n)
    );
    try {
      await authFetch('/api/notifications', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ids: [notification.id] }),
      });
      notifyUnreadChange();
    } catch {
      setNotifications(prev =>
        prev.map(n => n.id === notification.id ? { ...n, is_read: false } : n)
      );
    }
  }, [notifyUnreadChange]);

  // Mark all as read
  const markAllRead = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!profile?.companyId) return;
    const unreadIds = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).map(n => n.id);
    if (unreadIds.length === 0) return;
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, is_read: true })));
    try {
      await authFetch('/api/notifications', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ids: unreadIds }),
      });
      notifyUnreadChange();
    } catch {
      // revert on failure
      setNotifications(prev =>
        prev.map(n => unreadIds.includes(n.id) ? { ...n, is_read: false } : n)
      );
    }
  }, [profile?.companyId, notifications, notifyUnreadChange]);

  // Click notification
  const handleClick = useCallback((notification: Notification) => {
    markAsRead(notification);
    setSelectedNotification(notification);
  }, [markAsRead]);

  // Feedback on notification
  const handleFeedback = useCallback(async (notificationId: string, helpful: boolean, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (myFeedback[notificationId] !== undefined) return;
    // Optimistic update
    setMyFeedback(prev => ({ ...prev, [notificationId]: helpful }));
    try {
      await authFetch('/api/notification-feedback', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ notification_id: notificationId, helpful }),
      });
    } catch {
      setMyFeedback(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[notificationId];
        return next;
      });
    }
  }, [myFeedback, authFetch]);

  // Unread count
  const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;

  /* ─── Detail View ─── */
  if (selectedNotification) {
    const config = TYPE_CONFIG[selectedNotification.type] || TYPE_CONFIG.product_update;
    return (
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <button
          onClick={() => setSelectedNotification(null)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 mb-4 transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          返回消息列表
        </button>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <div className={`px-6 py-5 border-b ${config.borderColor} ${config.bgColor}`}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <span className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-medium ${config.bgColor} ${config.color}`}>
                {config.icon}
                {config.label}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                {formatTime(selectedNotification.created_at)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">{selectedNotification.title}</h1>
          </div>
          <div className="px-6 py-5">
            <div
              className="prose prose-sm max-w-none text-gray-700 leading-relaxed"
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: selectedNotification.content || '<p class="text-gray-400">暂无详细内容</p>' }}
            />
          </div>
          {/* Feedback buttons */}
          <div className="px-6 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">这条消息对您有帮助吗？</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleFeedback(selectedNotification.id, true)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] === true
                  ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'
                  : myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] === false
                    ? 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
                    : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700'
              }`}
              disabled={myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] !== undefined}
            >
              <ThumbsUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              有用
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleFeedback(selectedNotification.id, false)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] === false
                  ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
                  : myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] === true
                    ? 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
                    : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700'
              }`}
              disabled={myFeedback[selectedNotification.id] !== undefined}
            >
              <ThumbsDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              没用
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ─── List View ─── */
  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-sky-100 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-900" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">消息中心</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
              {unreadCount > 0 ? `${unreadCount}条未读消息` : '没有未读消息'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={markAllRead}
            className="text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-900 gap-1.5"
          >
            <CheckCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            全部已读
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Type Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-1 overflow-x-auto">
        {TABS.map(tab => {
          const count = tab.key === 'all'
            ? notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length
            : notifications.filter(n => n.type === tab.key && !n.is_read).length;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.key}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key)}
              className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
                activeTab === tab.key
                  ? 'bg-white text-gray-900 shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
              }`}
            >
              {tab.icon}
              {tab.label}
              {count > 0 && (
                <span className="min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-1 leading-none">
                  {count}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* 复盘提醒子筛选 */}
      {activeTab === 'review' && (
        <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
          {[
            { key: 'all', label: '全部' },
            { key: 'daily', label: '每日' },
            { key: 'weekly', label: '每周' },
            { key: 'monthly', label: '每月' },
          ].map(sub => (
            <button
              key={sub.key}
              onClick={() => setReviewSubFilter(sub.key)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                reviewSubFilter === sub.key
                  ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-100'
              }`}
            >
              {sub.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Message list */}
      {activeTab === 'work_order' ? (
        (() => {
          const filtered = workOrderSubFilter === 'all'
            ? workOrders
            : workOrders.filter(wo => {
                const statusMap: Record<string, string> = { pending: '待处理', processing: '处理中', completed: '已完成' };
                return wo.status === statusMap[workOrderSubFilter] || wo.status === workOrderSubFilter;
              });
          return (
            <>
              {/* 工单子筛选 */}
              <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
                {[
                  { key: 'all', label: '全部' },
                  { key: '待处理', label: '待处理' },
                  { key: '处理中', label: '处理中' },
                  { key: '已完成', label: '已完成' },
                ].map(sub => (
                  <button
                    key={sub.key}
                    onClick={() => setWorkOrderSubFilter(sub.key)}
                    className={`text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                      workOrderSubFilter === sub.key
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-blue-900 font-medium'
                        : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {sub.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
                  <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-sky-400" />
                </div>
              ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-gray-400">
                  <Wrench className="w-12 h-12 mb-3 opacity-40" />
                  <p className="text-sm">暂无工单提醒</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {filtered.map(wo => {
                    const statusColor: Record<string, string> = {
                      '待处理': 'bg-slate-100 text-blue-900',
                      '处理中': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
                      '已完成': 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
                    };
                    const priorityColor = wo.priority === '紧急' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';
                    const isExpanded = expandedWorkOrderId === wo.id;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={wo.id}
                        className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 hover:border-sky-200 hover:shadow-sm transition-all"
                      >
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setExpandedWorkOrderId(isExpanded ? null : wo.id)}
                          className="w-full text-left p-4"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                            <div className="mt-0.5 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 bg-slate-50 text-blue-900">
                              <Wrench className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                                <span className="text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium bg-slate-50 text-blue-900">工单提醒</span>
                                <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${statusColor[wo.status] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'}`}>{wo.status}</span>
                                <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${priorityColor}`}>{wo.priority}</span>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">{formatTime(wo.created_at)}</span>
                              </div>
                              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 truncate">
                                {wo.query?.slice(0, 30) || wo.customer_name}
                              </h3>
                              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                                {wo.customer_name}{wo.category ? ` · ${wo.category}` : ''}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 text-gray-300 shrink-0 mt-2 transition-transform ${isExpanded ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
                          </div>
                        </button>
                        {isExpanded && (
                          <div className="px-4 pb-4 space-y-3 border-t border-gray-100 pt-3">
                            {wo.ai_judgment && (
                              <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
                                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-900 mb-1">AI判断</p>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{wo.ai_judgment}</p>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {wo.ai_script && (
                              <div className="bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
                                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 mb-1">AI话术</p>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{wo.ai_script}</p>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {wo.result && (
                              <div className="bg-green-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
                                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-green-700 mb-1">处理结果</p>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{wo.result}</p>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-lg text-xs text-gray-500">
                              <span>工单ID: {wo.id.slice(0, 8)}</span>
                              {wo.completed_at && <span className="ml-4">完成时间: {formatTime(wo.completed_at)}</span>}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          );
        })()
      ) : (() => {
        // 复盘子筛选
        const filteredNotifications = activeTab === 'review' && reviewSubFilter !== 'all'
          ? notifications.filter(n => {
              if (n.type !== 'review') return false;
              const titleMap: Record<string, string> = { daily: '每日', weekly: '每周', monthly: '每月' };
              return n.title.includes(titleMap[reviewSubFilter] || '');
            })
          : notifications;

        return loading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-sky-400" />
        </div>
      ) : filteredNotifications.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-gray-400">
          <Bell className="w-12 h-12 mb-3 opacity-40" />
          <p className="text-sm">暂无消息</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filteredNotifications.map(notification => {
            const config = TYPE_CONFIG[notification.type] || TYPE_CONFIG.product_update;
            return (
              <button
                key={notification.id}
                onClick={() => handleClick(notification)}
                className="w-full text-left bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 hover:border-sky-200 hover:shadow-sm transition-all group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  {/* Type icon */}
                  <div className={`mt-0.5 w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${config.bgColor} ${config.color}`}>
                    {config.icon}
                  </div>

                  {/* Content */}
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${config.bgColor} ${config.color}`}>
                        {config.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">{formatTime(notification.created_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className={`text-sm font-medium group-hover:text-blue-900 transition-colors ${
                      notification.is_read ? 'text-gray-600' : 'text-gray-900'
                    }`}>
                      {notification.title}
                    </h3>
                    {notification.summary && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1 line-clamp-2">
                        {notification.summary}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Unread dot + feedback + arrow */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 mt-2">
                    {!notification.is_read && (
                      <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-900 animate-pulse" />
                    )}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button
